stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Series 4 Opens Tonight
stories.angle: The finale begins. Team Klingler (890 pts) opens against Team Flippen (750 pts) tonight at 7 PM ET on CBS Sports Network in Rosemont, Illinois. Lexi Kilfoyl (866) — who captained alongside Klingler as a teammate in Series 3 — now leads her own squad as the top rival. The gap is 24 points. Two days remain before the individual champion is crowned on August 30.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Series 4 is here. Klingler vs. Flippen TONIGHT — 7 PM ET on CBS Sports Network. Klingler leads 890-866 over Kilfoyl, who captains her own squad for the first time this season. 24 points separate first and second. Champion crowned Aug 30. #AUSL 🥎

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: In Series 3, Lexi Kilfoyl was on Team Klingler — helping her win. Tonight she captains her own squad against Klingler with a 24-point deficit and two games to make it up. Three Game MVPs. 866 points. The best challenger the race has seen. #AUSL #WomensSoftball 🥎

stories.title: Oklahoma — Gasso Coaching USA WNT While Building at Home
stories.angle: Patty Gasso, JT Gasso, and Jennifer Rocha are all serving on the USA Softball coaching staff for the Sept 12-16 World Cup Group Stage — meaning OU's entire top coaching staff will be away in OKC at the same time as four of their players. In Norman, the fall camp is already running with Sydney Berzon and Macie Harter integrating while Brito, Coleman, Jennings, and Maxwell are away. This is a fall unlike any OU has navigated before.

stories.title: Lexi Kilfoyl — The 2026 MVP Award Leader Enters Series 4 as a Captain
stories.angle: Lexi Kilfoyl has led the league in Game MVP awards this season with three — more than any other player. Until Series 4, she'd been earning points from other captains' rosters. Now the pitcher from the Chicago Bandits leads her own squad against Klingler and Flippen with a 24-point deficit and two days to make it up. In Series 3, she was on Klingler's winning team. Tonight, the dynamic flips.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Lexi Kilfoyl has more Game MVPs than anyone in the 2026 All-Star Cup. Until tonight, she earned them from other captains' rosters. Now she leads her own squad — 866 points, 24 back of Klingler — with two days to close the gap. #AUSL #WomensSoftball 🥎
